title: PrivateTariff
description: One normalized private-tariff row as produced by the ai-engine tariff pipeline (ADR-006 section 3) for append-only insertion into app.private_tariffs by core-api. The natural key is (carrier_or_agent, modal, origin_locode, dest_locode, equipment_or_unit, charge_category, charge_code) per RFC-002 step 3; versioning (batch, is_removed) is applied by core-api and is not part of the wire shape.

carrier_or_agent.description: Carrier or agent issuing the rate, normalized (e.g. HAPAG, MAEU, or the origin-agent name as written by the tenant).

charge_category.description: Mirrors app.charge_category: the platform's coarse grouping. Only OCEAN_FREIGHT and the AIR_FREIGHT base are markup-eligible (RFC-001 v1.3); everything else passes through at cost.

charge_code.description: Free-text carrier-specific code (BAF, THC, FSC...). Deliberately not an enum: codes arrive from tariffs the platform does not control.

net_amount.description: Net rate per unit (per container for FCL, per chargeable kg for AIR base freight, per unit otherwise). Never a JSON float.

min_amount.description: Minimum charge applied instead of net_amount when the computed amount is lower (AIR: max(min_amount, chargeable_kg x net_amount)).

valid_until.description: Inclusive. core-api enforces valid_from <= valid_until as a deterministic check.

search_description.description: Canonical service description embedded for retrieval ranking (codes filter first; vectors only rank valid rows).

source.description: PROPOSED EXTENSION (not in ADR-006's field list): provenance of this row. Needed because the decided ingestion path is the agent/carrier website via Firecrawl, not sheet uploads; app.tariff_source_type ('CSV_UPLOAD','RESEND_INBOUND') has no web value yet.

type.description: Mirrors app.tariff_source_type plus proposed web values. FIRECRAWL_PUBLIC requires source.ref and source.snapshot_id.

ref.description: Source locator: URL for FIRECRAWL_PUBLIC, filename for CSV_UPLOAD, resend_message_id for RESEND_INBOUND.

snapshot_id.description: Pinned public_snapshot the row was extracted from; makes the tariff reproducible (rule 9).
